title: Neon Orbits
description: Retro synthwave / progressive EDM. E harmonic minor. True 3:2 polyrhythm and a continuous seven-eighth-note 7/8 ostinato over 4/4 drums.
prompt: buatkan musik retro synthwave edm, dengan beat 4 on the floor beat dan menggunakan polyrithm dan polymeter ala deadmau5, dengan mode minor harmonic, gunakan semua skill yang terkait dengan ini, terutama /skill:mc dan skill di dalam repo
assumptions: Instrumental, original musical material; artist reference interpreted as evolving layered sequences and gradual filter development, not a copied song.
124 BPM, 4/4, 164 bars including release; E F# G A B C D# throughout.
Strict grid 1/48, 960 PPQN: straight 1/16 and 2/3-beat attacks share a 1/12-beat lattice; no swing or onset jitter.
Seven Serum 2 instruments and six separate drum parts. All drum triggers are pitch 60 / Cubase C3; kit and samples remain the user's choice.
No combined MIDI, audio, or Cubase project requested. Native Serum preset per melodic layer.
